reviews.title: Buggy and horrible, scammy and constant pop ups
reviews.text: The core of this game is fun but you will be prompted to spend money every few seconds, I got to level 5 and it is still in some obnoxious tutorial mode that does not let you do anything, ads pop up out of nowhere, and it’ll prompt you to play an unrelated mini game with an exit button, if you exit out because the mini game looks dumb it’ll not let you do anything else, prompt you to click on the mini game again, this time with no exit button. Not one single person working on this game cares about it being fun or user friendly. It reminds me of trying to get on a computer in the early 2000s after you got a virus and being bombarded with constant pop ups

reviews.title: Too Many Ads & Has the Game Been Copied?
reviews.text:
I found the game through Fetch. I like the game, but I agree there are too many ads. Maybe I’ve become a little immune but it doesn’t feel like there are a gazillion ads like other reviews say, but there are a lot. I like the actual game, but I made it through all the characters. Now all I’m doing is merging with very little reward. I hope there’s an update soon. 

The real reason I’m writing this review is also to let people know there’s a game called Beach Bliss by Kite that’s basically the exact same game as Glow Tales. There are slight differences but the items you merge, the special events, the treasure chests, and even the main character are the same. I honestly thought the makers of Glow Tales decided to make a new game instead of updating the original. Do with this info as you will.

reviews.title: Holy sweet mother of Ads
reviews.text:
This is an ad farm, Plain and simple. 
If I could give it 0 stars I would. The sad part about is, the actual game is good. I’ve played alot of merge games, they aren’t new but they have a good concept here. Then you start to play and you can’t blink without another ad being in your face. I have never seen anything like it, or felt so strongly over a game to come write a review but this is WILD! I started playing for fetch points but it’s not even worth it anymore. If you’re playing this for fun, don’t. Unless you plan on buying ad free, and honestly with this tactic I wouldn’t even give them money for that.
